verdict.rationale: Mercury documents free savings accounts and up to 3.89% yield through Treasury by Mercury Advisory. Its internal-transfer endpoint moves funds between checking, savings and treasury accounts within an organization. A long-time customer independently reports running dozens of purpose-named accounts with auto-funding rules, so the cushion-building flow appears real. However, no first-party documentation describes automated transfer rules, and the yield is tied to Treasury rather than the savings sub-account itself. Missing for 10: first-party docs on rule-based automatic transfers (triggers, thresholds, schedules), explicit high-yield savings sub-account mechanics, hands-on corroboration beyond one community comment.
